title: Admins can search Spaces, Circles and Events in their consoles

source.ref: Search coverage scan 2026-11-17 (project thread: Make search cover every public item)

detail:
Admin search depth (owner ask 2026-11-17). Members, CRM contacts, campaigns and Practices have search boxes; /admin/spaces (42 active Spaces, every row in one long health list), /admin/circles (78 Circles in one table) and /admin/events (493 published events; its only search box finds a member to assign as host) have none. Fix: the kit FilterBar `q` (ADR-233) on Spaces and Events, read server-side, and a search field on the Circles table, matching name, brand, slug, place and host.

DONE 2026-11-17: /admin/spaces takes the FilterBar ?q= (name, brand, slug, city, tagline, type), /admin/circles has a search field over name, place, hub and host, and /admin/events has a janitor Find an event section across every status and visibility.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
